message.content:
I’m ready to transcribe, but I don’t see an audio file attached. Please provide the audio (upload the file or share a link) and I’ll transcribe it.

Tell me your preferences for the transcript:
- Style: Verbatim (every utterance, including stutters and filler) or Clean (readable, punctuation normalized, minimal filler)
- Speakers: Do you want speaker labels (e.g., Speaker 1, Speaker 2) if there are multiple people?
- Timestamps: Include time codes? If yes, how often (every sentence, per speaker change, or at regular intervals like every 30 seconds)?
- Output format: Plain text, or SRT/VTT for subtitles, or another format
- Language/ dialect: Please specify if not standard English (or if there are multiple languages)

If you can’t attach a file, you can paste a short sample so I can show you the style, or share a link to the audio.
